prompts.title: 水果提示中的超现实农业文明
prompts.description: 一个极具创意和细节的提示，用于生成一幅超现实图像：一个被切开的单一水果中包含着一个完整的农业文明，将植物学插画与博斯（Bosch）风格的密集内部场景融为一体。
prompts.content:
A single {argument name="fruit or vegetable" default="[FRUIT/VEGETABLE]"} suspended in space, sliced open to reveal it contains an entire agricultural civilization. Inside the fruit's flesh: terraced farms follow the curve of the rind, irrigation channels trace the paths of juice vessels, tiny farmers tend crops that are the fruit's own seeds, villages cluster near the core, harvest festivals celebrate in the chambers. The fruit's skin becomes their sky. Seasons pass in different sections simultaneously. Root structures below mirror branch structures of family trees. Everything edible is also everything lived. The interdependence of human and harvest made literal. Dramatic rimlight, agricultural amber and chlorophyll green, botanical illustration precision meets Bosch-like populated interior, 8K, the food chain as food chain.

In the background, there is a warm, circular chandelier and wooden slatted room dividers, creating a cozy yet sophisticated atmosphere.
